motion_cues.config.title: Motion Cues Settings
motion_cues.config.enabled.tooltip:
Shows motion cues while moving or rotating the view
Default: On
motion_cues.config.show_config_preview.t: Show or hide the live preview on this settings screen.
motion_cues.config.visibility_mode.toolt:
Controls when resting dots remain visible.
Options: Motion Only, Always in Gameplay, Always
Default: Motion Only
motion_cues.config.idle_fade_delay.toolt:
In Motion Only mode, keeps dots fully visible for this many seconds after motion stops, then begins the normal fade.
Range: 0 – 60 seconds
Default: 1.5 seconds
motion_cues.config.sensitivity.tooltip:
Strength of camera-plane acceleration and part of the depth response.
Range: 10 – 400
Default: 110
motion_cues.config.smoothing.tooltip:
How quickly cues react to new motion; higher values react faster.
Range: 0.05 – 1
Default: 0.28
motion_cues.config.max_flow_speed.toolti:
Maximum dot movement in GUI pixels per game tick.
Range: 0.5 – 30
Default: 7
motion_cues.config.movement_threshold.to:
Ignores tiny position or network corrections.
Range: 0 – 0.2
Default: 0.003
motion_cues.config.view_projection_descr: Full 3D camera projection is used: acceleration perpendicular to the view moves the dots, while acceleration along the view ray changes their size.
motion_cues.config.depth_effect_strength:
Controls size changes caused by acceleration along the view ray.
Range: 0 – 2
Default: 0.8
Animates dots when turning the view, even while standing still
Default: On
motion_cues.config.yaw_sensitivity.toolt:
Strength of cues caused by looking left or right; 0 disables this axis.
Range: 0 – 1
Default: 0.16
motion_cues.config.pitch_sensitivity.too:
Strength of cues caused by looking up or down; 0 disables this axis.
Range: 0 – 1
Default: 0.12
motion_cues.config.color_mode.tooltip:
Adaptive chooses a light or dark neutral from local luminance; Difference is mathematical inversion; Fixed uses the selected color
Default: Adaptive Contrast
motion_cues.config.adaptive_threshold.to:
Backgrounds below this perceptual luminance use a light dot; backgrounds above it use a dark dot.
Range: 0.1 – 0.9
Default: 0.58
motion_cues.config.adaptive_transition.t:
Softens the light/dark switch near the threshold.
Range: 0.001 – 0.25
Default: 0.06
motion_cues.config.dot_color.tooltip:
Color used in Fixed mode.
RGB Range: #000000 – #FFFFFF
Default: #E8E8E8
motion_cues.config.opacity.tooltip:
Maximum cue opacity or adaptive/difference contrast strength.
Range: 0.1 – 1
Default: 0.72
motion_cues.config.dot_radius.tooltip:
Base dot radius in GUI pixels.
Range: 1 – 12
Default: 4
motion_cues.config.edge_margin.tooltip:
Distance from the outermost dot center to the screen edge, in GUI pixels.
Range: 0 – 80
Default: 14
motion_cues.config.columns_per_side.tool:
Number of visible columns per side during gentle motion.
Range: 1 – 3
Default: 2
Maximum columns revealed during strong lateral acceleration; never lower than resting columns.
Range: 1 – 20
Default: 8
motion_cues.config.dots_per_column.toolt:
Vertical dot density in each column.
Range: 1 – 20
Default: 6
motion_cues.config.column_spacing.toolti:
Horizontal distance between columns in GUI pixels.
Range: 2 – 40
Default: 14
motion_cues.config.vertical_coverage.too:
Fraction of screen height occupied by the dot field.
Range: 0.25 – 0.95
Default: 0.78
motion_cues.config.horizontal_coverage.t:
Maximum fraction of screen width used by each side.
Range: 0.08 – 0.48
Default: 0.28
